cards.text: After the flood, the nations spread out from Noah's sons (Genesis 10:32). Now the whole world has one language and a common form of speech. No translator, no subtitles, no "sorry, say that again?" Friend, that's a WONDERFUL world.
People journeying eastward find a plain and settle down right there. After years in a junk drawer, baker, an open plain sounds like a MANSION to me.

cards.question: Journeying eastward, the people find a plain and settle there. What land is it in?

cards.text: They say to one another, "Come, let us make bricks and bake them thoroughly." Baker, I once left a batch in so long those cookies could've held up a wall.

cards.question: The people build with the bricks they baked. They use brick instead of ___, and tar instead of mortar.

cards.text: Friend, they went from baking bricks to planning a SKYLINE: "Come," they say, "let us build for ourselves a city with a tower that reaches to the heavens…"

cards.question: The people want to build a city with a tower that reaches to the heavens. What do they say it's for?

answers.text: To make a name for themselves
To guard the plain from enemies

cards.question: The people also say building the city with its tower will keep them from being scattered over the face of all the earth.

cards.text: Brick by brick, up it goes, and then the LORD comes down to see the city and the tower. Friend, they're building that thing to reach the heavens, and the LORD still comes DOWN to see it.
Then the LORD says, "If they have begun to do this as one people speaking the same language…"

cards.question: The LORD says if the builders have begun this as one people speaking the same language, then something follows. What does He say follows?

answers.text: Nothing they plan will be out of their reach
Their city will grow too big for the plain
Their tower will fall before it is finished

cards.question: Then the LORD says, "Come, let Us go down…" What does He say He'll go down and do to the builders?

cards.text: The LORD says it's "so that they will not understand one another's speech." Picture a work meeting where everybody's talking and NOBODY understands anybody.
So the LORD scatters them from there over the face of all the earth, the very thing that city and tower were supposed to prevent. Yeah, THAT one.

cards.question: Once the LORD scatters the people, they keep right on building the city.
The place where the LORD confused the language of the whole world and scattered the people is called ___.
